TUD Dresden University of Technology, as a University of Excellence, is one of the leading and most dynamic research institutions in the country. For TUD diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.Within the DFG-funded interdisciplinary research unit GArua: “Fog-dependent water relations and plant invasion in the Galápagos Archipelago under climate change” (https://www.uni-marburg.de/en/prfolder-en/news/when-the-garua-disappears-a-new-research-unit-will-study-the-future-of-the-galapagos-cloud-forests), the Faculty of Environmental Sciences, Department of Forest Sciences, Institute of Forest Botany and Forest Zoology, Chair of Forest Botany offers a position asResearch Associate / PhD Student (m/f/x)in Tropical tree ecophysiology and tree water relations(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)starting January 1, 2027. The position is limited until July 31, 2030, with the possibility of extension up to a total employment duration of four years and entails 65% of the full-time weekly hours. The period of employment is governed by the Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG). The position offers the chance to obtain further academic qualification (usually PhD). Within this collaborative research project, the research associate will be responsible for the installation and maintenance of sap flow sensors and automated dendrometers for quantifying tree water use and status of native and exotic shrub and tree species, for hydraulic characterization as well as for several measurement campaigns.an excellent university degree in forest or plant ecology, ecophysiology, environmental sciences, or a related discipline with field and/or lab experiencewillingness for several long-term stays at the Charles Darwin Research Station, main island of the Galapagos Archipelago, Ecuador, as well as to familiarize oneself with technical installations and sensor networkscapability for intensive fieldwork campaigns in harsh environmental conditions is essential while advanced understanding of tree water relations is a plusproven scientific writing skills is essential, while advanced knowledge in statistical analyses with R is a plusproven experience in working in diverse teams, team-oriented and willing to learn and work independentlyadvanced command of English is essential while basic knowledge of Spanish and/or German is desirablejoint doctoral studies together with further PhD student in other subprojects working on Galapagosan inspiring, international and interdisciplinary working environment, specialized in forest and plant ecology, ecophysiology and plant hydraulicsattractive working conditions and opportunities for further professional development at TUDFor project-related questions, please contact Prof. Dr. Bernhard Schuldt (bernhard.schuldt@tu-dresden.de).

The University Medical Center Schleswig-Holstein (UKSH) combines world-class international research with interdisciplinary patient care. We are the state's only comprehensive care provider and its largest employer. Our approximately 17,500 employees ensure highly personalized care—which is indispensable for the people of Schleswig-Holstein.The University Hospital Schleswig-Holstein (UKSH) with its locations in Kiel and Lübeck is one of the largest medical care centers in Europe. It serves to warrant maximum medical care in the northernmost federal state and guarantees medical-technical care at the highest level, especially for patients who require highly differentiated diagnosis and therapy. The unique feature of university medicine is the interaction of health care, research and teaching with the result that scientific findings flow directly into the health system.Our research aims to develop novel diagnostic and therapeutic strategies for chronic inflammatory diseases, including inflammatory bowel, liver, lung and skin diseases. To achieve this, we investigate the cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying immune regulation in different disease contexts and employ state-of-the-art technologies to comprehensively characterize human immune cells, with a particular focus on antigen-specific CD4+ T cells. A major focus of our research is the integration of high-dimensional single-cell and immune repertoire data. Our group combines enrichment of rare antigen-specific CD4+ T cells with multidimensional flow cytometry, single-cell RNA sequencing, T cell receptor sequencing and ATAC sequencing to investigate cellular states, immune cell differentiation, clonality and regulatory mechanisms in health and disease.As a PhD student / postdoctoral researcher in bioinformatics, you will be an integral part of the research activities within our group. You will develop and pursue independent research projects and also contribute to a broad range of collaborative projects involving different members of the group. Your work will focus on the computational analysis, integration and interpretation of high-dimensional sequencing data, with particular emphasis on:- Analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing, T cell receptor sequencing, and ATAC sequencing data- Integration of transcriptomic, TCR, epigenetic and flow cytometry data to characterize immune cell states and regulatory mechanisms- Development and application of reproducible bioinformatics workflows and analysis pipelines, including data visualization and interpretation- Active contribution to diverse collaborative projects within the group, including the planning and design of computational analyses in close interaction with experimental scientistsStart in our team:Join our research team starting from February 1st 2027. The position is initially limited to two years, with the possibility of extension. We are looking forward to welcoming you as part of our team with all your skills and commitment.What we offer:- Salary will be according to the German salary scale TV-L (German TV-L E13, PhD student 65%, Postdoc 100%)- A full-time position, currently 38,5 hours/week; part-time employment may be compatible within the framework of certain working time models- Exceptional technical infrastructure especially for multi-dimensional flow-cytometry and for next generation sequencing at the the Institute of Medical Immunology and the Center of Molecular Biosciences (ZMB)- You can find more exciting benefits offered by the UKSH here:Benefits (uksh.de)What you can expect:- A fascinating research environment for the investigation of basic processes of human immune reactions with direct implications for immune-mediated diseases- A systematic training to work independently in a challenging and diversified research field- The opportunity to work in a dedicated, supportive and international research team- An extensive pool of sophisticated methods and complex laboratory instrumentsWhatyou bring with you:University degree (Master's or equivalent) in bioinformatics, computational biology, biology, biostatistics, data science or a related field; completed PhD required for postdoctoral positionsStrong interest in single-cell omics, immunology and computational analysis of biological dataExperience with next-generation sequencing technologies (e.g. scRNA-seq, TCR-seq or ATAC-seq) is desirableGood programming skills in R and/or Python, including the development, adaptation and documentation of computational workflowsHigh degree of commitment, independence, organizational skills and responsibility, along with strong communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate effectively with experimental and clinical teamsWe look forward to receiving your application (CV, motivation letter stating research and career interests, copies of education certificates, and two letters of recommendation) by 29.10.2026; please include job posting number 29445.

Regulatory & Audit Management* Manage insurance premium tax audits and regulatory reviews independently.* Act as the primary contact for tax authorities, auditors, legal advisors, insurers, and brokers.* Develop strategies to address audit findings and mitigate regulatory risks.* Monitor developments in German and international insurance tax legislation and relevant court decisions.* Ensure regulatory awareness and compliance regarding insurance distribution activities in Germany. Cross-Functional Collaboration* Work closely with colleagues from Tax, Legal, Treasury, Procurement, Risk Management, and other business functions.* Support DHL business units in understanding and meeting insurance compliance requirements.* Coordinate with external advisors, brokers, insurers, and regulatory stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions. What You Bring* University degree in Law, Tax, Business Administration, Finance, Insurance, Risk Management, or a related field.* Several years of professional experience in insurance taxation, insurance regulation, compliance, risk management, legal, or related disciplines.* Proven expertise in German Insurance Premium Tax (IPT) regulations and insurance compliance requirements.* Experience managing regulatory inquiries, audits, disputes, and complex multinational insurance programs.* Strong understanding of commercial insurance products, including Property, Liability, Marine, Cargo, Cyber, D&O, Financial Lines, and Employee Benefits.* Experience developing governance, control, and compliance frameworks in international organizations.* Excellent English language skills and good German language proficiency. You combine technical expertise with strong stakeholder management skills and are comfortable advising senior decision-makers. You thrive in international settings, communicate effectively, and maintain the highest standards of integrity and quality. Who We Are 🌍Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap.We are a team of twelve in Chemnitz, spanning data, ML, HPC, hardware and industrialization. Early adopters across Europe and Asia already use our technology. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team.What You'll Do 🔧Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer.- Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production- Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour.- **Make throughput a design decision:**Build modular, parameterizable nodes for our distributed processing pipeline and help bring them into our Rust-based production environment.- **Ship modules, not scripts:**Automate evaluations end to end, from raw data to reports for our engineering team and our customers.- Own customer projects technically: Assess requirements, communicate interim results and findings, and turn feedback into improvements.What You Bring 🕵️- Measurement experience: A degree in electrical engineering (or comparable) and 3+ years with real-world measurement data. Sampling, noise, filtering and artifacts you know from practice, not just lectures.- Physical intuition: You can explain why a feature makes sense, and you prefer a simple, well-understood method over a model nobody can explain.- Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing.- Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it.- Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain results clearly to engineers and managers alike.Why Limatica 🚀- Real ownership: Your own part of the pipeline and your first customer project within months. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead.- Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers.- Share the upside: Salary package including virtual stock options.- Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning- Flexibility & wellbeing: Flexible hours, hybrid work, further benefits via Guud CardWhat it's like here: You get a lot of trust and a lot of room to shape things. We look for people who stay with a problem until it's solved and who enjoy the moments when a customer launch needs the whole team. Those are the moments where people here grow fastest. This role is intentionally a towards-senior position. You will take on increasing responsibility for pipeline modules and customer projects. Those who help shape the architecture and lead projects independently grow into a senior role with us.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Maximal 20%Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Kundenberatung, -betreuungExpertenkenntnisse: Datenanalyse, Elektrotechnik
